name: learner_stage_select
description: Select exactly one owned Workflow for this Learner staging session; all of its private memories become readable/editable in this session. Revision calls cannot switch away from the host-authorized target. For initialization use workflow_create to create a staged target, or select an existing candidate.

workflow_id.description: Exact owned Workflow ID from workflow_list/get or trusted staging state. Selects one session target; REVISE cannot switch away from its host-authorized target.

base_version.description: Existing Workflow baseline version, or null for a new staged Workflow.

committed.description: Always false here; only a host commit receipt proves formal persistence.

completion_blockers.description: Host-detected blockers. Empty does not itself commit or validate every business claim.

memory_count.description: Count of target Workflow memories in the staging overlay; not a committed write receipt.

path.description: Host-authorized path; model input cannot change it.

protocol.description: Host staging protocol, not a model-selected format.

session_id.description: Exact server-generated staging session ID; use unchanged in completion marker.

staged.description: This result describes an overlay only.

staging_revision.description: Exact revision after staged edits. Re-read and use unchanged in final READY_TO_COMMIT marker.

workflow_id.description: Selected staged Workflow ID, or empty before selection/create. Does not grant unrelated Workflow access.

workflow_status.description: Current staged status; empty before selection/create. Initialization must explicitly reach active.

name: learner_stage_state

term.description: Academic term: 1 or 2, used with academic_year.

name: schedule_query
description: 查询当前用户的有效日程。按学年/学期/教学周，或带时区的from/to时间范围查询；范围最长366天，区间[from,to)重叠匹配。两类条件同时提供时按AND组合。按start_time,id排序，默认100条，limit最大1000，offset最大100000；空页结束，page_limit_reason=offset_limit时停止，不再使用next_offset。教学周不是自然周。

academic_year.description: Academic year starting year; 2026 means academic year 2026–2027. Must come from the user's actual calendar, not an inferred year.

from.description: Inclusive lower boundary of [from,to); matches occurrences overlapping this range. Supply together with to; maximum 366 days.

limit.description: Maximum returned rows, default 100; a nonempty page is not proof of complete coverage.

offset.description: First query omits this or uses 0. Continue with returned next_offset using unchanged filters. Stop on an empty page or page_limit_reason=offset_limit; do not reuse an out-of-range next_offset.

teaching_week.description: Teaching-week number in the selected academic term, not ISO or calendar week.

term.description: Academic term: 1 or 2, used with academic_year.

to.description: Exclusive upper boundary of [from,to), after from. Supply together with from.

name: schedule_update
description: 修改日程或完成状态。先get核实；mode必填TEMPORARY/PERMANENT，至少提供一个修改字段。省略字段保留；details空串清除，null不接受。课表TEMPORARY只改选定周，PERMANENT影响同系列当前及后续周；event_status仅作用于选定日程。返回选定条目，不代表只影响这一条；没有预期版本参数或撤销保证，不可盲重试。

id.description: Current user's persisted schedule occurrence ID returned by schedule_query/get. Read it before updating.

mode.description: Required scope. TEMPORARY changes only the selected timetable week. PERMANENT changes the same timetable series from the selected week onward. Non-timetable schedules change only this occurrence. event_status applies only to the selected occurrence.
